node.title: A fixed rank-nine chart alone does not pay its selector population
node.closure: explicit official-row weighted-plane countermodel to a chart-local cap
node.statement: On the official KoalaBear residual row there is a ten-dimensional RS correction space, a fixed nine-subset of evaluation rank nine, and 4070408 pair-noncontained exact-support slopes in its rank-nine owner plane. The plane has common pair core K-1, every record has a rank-ten eleven-subset on an affine-owner component, and the errors have affine rank at most two. Since 4070408>2578110, the current fixed-chart conclusions alone cannot pay the selector population; a successful continuation must retain additional ancestor incidence data or couple charts through chronology.
